convert_indices_to_text: convert a list of token indices to a readable string using an alphabet mapping
convert_batch_indices_to_text: convert a batch of token indices to a list of strings with optional length constraints
mask_random_word_span: mask a random span of sequential words in a text using geometric distribution
swap_random_sentences: swap sentences in a list with a given probability to augment text data
delete_random_words: delete words from a sentence with a given probability for data augmentation
